headline: Leon Black 🚶‍♂️💨 WALKS OUT Epstein Hearing 🏛️🕵️‍♂️ NDA STUNT 🎭💼
text: Billionaire Leon Black 🕴️💰 just YEETED 🚪💨 out of a closed-door Capitol hearing 🏛️🔒 after lawmakers asked about those spicy NDAs 🔒🤫 signed to silence Epstein victims 😱💸. The House Oversight Committee 🍑👨‍⚖️ dropped TWO SUBPOENAS 📜⚖️ forcing the Apollo Global Management co-founder 🏢👑 to testify on camera 📹🎥 and under oath 🗣️🙋‍♂️ about Jeffrey Epstein's role in the hush money 🤐💵 game. Black, whose name popped like champagne 🍾 in the Epstein files 📂🗂️, walked in voluntarily but bounced 🏃‍♂️💨 the second they mentioned NDAs, leaving his lawyers to drop the final mic 🎤👋. Committee Chair James Comer 🍆👴 wants the deets: "Was Epstein writing these NDAs? Handing out the hush cash? Why the gag orders?" 🧐💬 Black's lawyers called it a "political stunt" 🎭🤡 while insisting Epstein had zero involvement with any NDAs. Meanwhile, Black dropped the Jekyll-Hyde line 🧪👹: "I knew Jekyll, didn't know Hyde" and swore he paid Epstein $158M 💸📉 for "legit tax advice" 🧾✅, not for access to women or blackmail schemes 🖤🚫. The committee isn't buying it, especially after learning Epstein suggested sending ex-cops 🚔👮‍♂️ to intimidate Russian model Guzel Ganieva 😡💼 into signing an NDA, which Black allegedly drafted to cover up a six-year affair 💏🔥. Black's team says Ganieva's abuse claims are "demonstrably false" ❌ and that he was the real extortion victim 🤑😭. Top Dem Robert Garcia 🔥👨‍💼 said Black "stormed out" when pressed about NDAs and survivor justice, warning the tycoon will be held accountable if he ghosts the subpoenas 👻⚖️. Meanwhile Bank of America 💳🏦 just paid $72.5M over its own Epstein lawsuit 🤯💸, proving the Epstein web 🕸️🐙 keeps snaring Wall Street whales 🐋📉. No NDA can hide this drama forever 📜🚫!
